title: With a year of utility bills
question: Given one year of bills, how close is our prediction of the next year?
caveats: Calibrated on 2016 bills, tested on 2017, a year the model never saw; same 44 buildings in both columns.
Only 44 of 283 eligible buildings (16%) calibrate today; the rest are excluded, not shown at their uncalibrated values.
The 44 were already our closest (18% error without bills vs 49% across all 283), so this shows bills finishing the job on buildings we nearly fit, not a 53%-to-4% improvement.
The ranges barely improve even when the estimate does: the range problem is in how ranges are built.

provenance.method: ASHRAE Guideline 14 / IPMVP Option D, MV-04 tolerances; buildings that do not converge abstain
provenance.note: Aggregate only. The per-building output stays in the git-ignored cache at data/cache/evals/out/calibrated.json.
